Name: Pelican Town Municipal - Custom NPC
Author: MidnightVoyager
Description:
For too long too long, Pelican Town's been without its own post office and legal services. No longer do the locals have to commute just to renew their driver's license, and no longer does the mail carrier have to cart everything around town and then to the post office out of town. And god knows they don't have much space in town to build anything, so it's all stuffed in one building.

[color=#29292e]Content[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-801089181.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
This mod adds a municipal building for the post office and sheriff's office. It also adds an anti-social NPC legal clerk to run a shop and the sheriff himself as a full new NPC. He cannot be married.

My inspiration was watching Andy Griffith as a kid and growing up in a small town that I saw change with the advent of big box stores and just a lot of general growth. (My inspiration was not the other police mod, I was pretty surprised when that came out a few months into making this one!) I even modeled the building a bit after Mayberry's courthouse. Expect a slow, contemplative kind of plot that's more about past experiences informing the future. I aim for a roughly vanilla experience and hope to integrate this building and NPC cleanly into most any game.

[color=#29292e]Characters[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-1017331851.png[/img][/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760914105-133391786.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Sheriff William "Bill" Stewart is a friendly, even-tempered gay widower with an adult daughter. He was born in a small town but mostly worked the force in a big city. He's a bit of a rambler who likes reading and fishing. You'll meet him right after the event where Morris hands out coupons at Pierre's, the same day the municipal building opens. He has a conditional random pool of daily dialog that changes based on heart level, season, day of the week, and other mods you may have installed and their conditions.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760914105-1502528739.png[/img]﻿[/center]
Alicia Hunt is a legal clerk who won't be hanging around for festivals or evenings. She's commuting here for the peace and quiet after nearly burning out in a hectic, cutthroat professional environment. Her family's all in Zuzu, and she spends her free time there. She is an antisocial NPC.

[color=#29292e]Trigger Warnings[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906000-2056249257.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[b]TLDR:[/b] There will be discussion of police violence and topics around it. They will not be graphic or particularly in-depth. There will also be mention of past homophobia and racism from characters you will not meet alongside people being jerks about adoption, seen in flashback. It's a single scene that leads to family members being cut off. And finally, there will be mention of the consequences of policing drugs and alcohol addictions as moral failings and crimes instead of a sickness. Some situations are unavoidably reminiscent of IRL situations. I try not to go any darker than Shane considering cliff jumping.

[b]MORE DETAIL:[/b] I try to preserve the vibe of Stardew as a place safe for diverse people, so these problems are all in other places. The focus is on avoiding them in the future. But it doesn't feel very genuine to write this character and avoid these topics. These topics are all inherent to having a gay police officer character who seeks reform in a small town.

If you're the sort of person who might be anxious about an officer being around, don't worry! Bill is a cop that will not carry a weapon, he will not put anyone in a cell, and he will always try to work out people's problems before resorting to fines and penalties. He doesn't care about your race, sex, orientation, neurodivergent status, or wealth. He just wants to help, and he's aware that it's a real privilege that he can decide to police that way.

[*]STAMPS! Seasonal stock, used as gifts.[/*]
[*]Fire extinguisher and cabinet. These are available in tilesheet form in my tilesheet mod, but now you can put then in your home! Residents will as well one the building opens. Configurable in settings under Fire Safety.[/*]
[*]Krobus's decorative chime, available from his store (and added to Nicer Sewer for consistency)[/*]
[*]Two new recipes, sent at 3 and 7 hearts like vanilla NPCs.[/*]
[*]After Bill's 10 heart event, community improvements such as a Little Free Pantry, clothing donation box, and gold donation box![/*]
[*]Rival Hearts with the wizard! (Starts in the fall. Bill is gay, and this will be disabled if you use mods that make the wizard a woman)[/*]
[*]A new crop, the Mana Bloom, and a potion that will restore mana if you use Wizardry[/*]
[*]DSV-compatible portraits for Marlon and the Wizard! (Optional, but recommended if you don't have mods that give them more expressions)[/*]

[list=1]

[/list]
[list]
[*]If you use Mail Services, do not turn in quest items via mail without the option in that mod checked to "Show Dialog On Shipment." It will break quests that have dialog flags.[/*]
[*]If you use Pen Pals, do not turn in quest items via mail.[/*]
[/list][color=#29292e]Compatibility[/color]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/38698/38698-1760906055-1085614367.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
[list]
[*]Nyapu-style portraits [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40020]here[/url]﻿, by Nugmods![/*]
[*]I don't know of any problems with a late install, but there might be some oddness. Mainly, Morris factors into the intro, which is supposed to run directly after Morris hands out coupons at Pierre's. And some events may just stack up because their triggers have all passed.[/*]
[*]If you are playing something that changes who the mayor is, that will also be odd without further patching, because the mod generally assumes Lewis is the mayor.[/*]
[*]There's versions of the interior tilesheet to match DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors, VPR, and Starblue that will automatically enable if you have interiors enabled for VPR or Starblue or if you use Earthy Interiors.[/*]
[*]Exterior recolors are automatically detected, though this feature is just used for the building added to the map page, some seasonal decorations, and the Little Free Pantry. Supports DaisyNiko's Earthy, VPR, Starblue, and Overgrown Vintage Map. The latter should override any of the others on the map page.[/*]
[*]Compatible with Stardew Valley Maps Retouched. Built in patches for Paved Valley, Overgrown Valley, Haley's Bakery, and Lasting Conversation Topics.[/*]
[*]Compatibility with Seven Deadly Sins is not heavily tested, but I scooted over the big stall they had where my building was. Might cause anyone who stands near the tree to act a little odd, but it should be good enough.[/*]
[*]The two recipes have variants for Cornucopia Cooking Recipes, if you have that mod's World Traveler config activated. If not, they use vanilla ingredients.[/*]
[*]For SVE and Ridgeside: The mod auto-detects SVE and auto-detects if you are using Ridgeside's expanded festival maps and patches festivals accordingly.[/*]
[*](Incidentally, it fixes a minor bug in the Ridgeside/SVE combo at the bottom of the Ridgeside area of the fair in year 1 and the inaccessibility of the shortcut out of the maze at Halloween. You may not even notice it, but I did since I thought I was causing it!)[/*]
[*]Speaking of festivals, Feast of the Sun wreaths will appear on the Municipal Building if town wreaths are enabled in that mod.[/*]
[*]It's technically probably compatible with Law and Order Stardew Valley, in that they don't take up the same space. But there will be two sheriffs who sheriff quite differently and two police locations.[/*]
[*]They Deserve It: Portraits For All compatibility is in place for Central Station tourists and/or festival tourists.[/*]
[*]Romanceable Rasmodia and Piper: A Pierre Rewrite have pronoun compatibility when either is referred to.[/*]
[*]Wizard Enhanced, SVE, Romanceable Rasmodia, and Romanceable Rasmodius in general should be fine, wizard-wise. I designed Bill's basic wizard interactions around a day where he's/she's home in all of the above. Rival Hearts schedule changes work for basic RomRas, Wizard Enhanced's schedule option (auto-detects your settings), and SVE or SVE + RomRas for SVE.[/*]
[*]Mana Elixir restores mana instead of health if you have Wizardry.[/*]
[*]Supports Diverse Stardew Valley's nonbinary Sebastian, Abigail, and Emily.[/*]
[*]Supports Guildmaster Marlen's pronouns.[/*]
[*]I never refer to the farmer by gender, so no gender neutrality support is needed. Gender: abolished.[/*]
[*]Fire extinguishers use overlays on specific layers for as much compatibility as possible. This means I don't have to do a bunch of patches for different interior mods. I chose the locations and map layers of these for as much compatibility with everything I could find as possible, but Less Ugly Town Interiors, Alchemistry for the doctor's office, and SVE needed some location variants in places. These will reflect your location settings in LUTI and Alchemistry as well.[/*]
